query: How can I apply for or renew APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC)?
reference_answer: All APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC) applications must be submitted online at the e-Service. The card will be mailed by registered post to the applicant when it is ready.

All APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC) applications must be submitted online at the e-Service. The card will be mailed by registered post to the applicant when it is ready.

You can apply for visa as Individual User if you are applying for individuals/families for the purpose of social visit. Singapore registered business entity applying for visa applicants for the purpose of business visit should apply for visa as Business User. In addition, the local contact who submits the visa application must be either a Singapore citizen or a Singapore permanent resident who is at least 21 years old with a Singpass account.

The validity of the ABTC is five years or up to the validity of the passport, whichever is shorter. However, if your Singapore passport number has changed, you need to apply for a new ABTC under the category of 'replacement due to change of particulars'. You should submit an application only after you have collected your new passport.

answer: To apply for or renew an APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC), go to the e-Service online. Applications must include a valid passport and proof of purpose (individual or business user). The card is valid for 5 years or until your passport expires, whichever is shorter. After collecting a new passport, apply for a replacement ABTC. Collect documents for the ABTC at separate appointments. [Document 1]
